title: Paint Outside the Box: Synthesizing and Selecting Training Data for Visual Grounding
abstract: arXiv:2412.00684v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Visual grounding aims to localize the image regions based on a textual query. Given the difficulty of large-scale data curation, we investigate how to effectively learn visual grounding under data-scarce settings in this paper. To address the data scarcity, we propose a novel framework, POBF (Paint Outside the Box and Filter). POBF synthesizes images by inpainting outside the box, tackling a label misalignment issue encountered in previous works. Furthermore, POBF leverages an innovative filtering scheme to select the most effective training data. This scheme combines a hardness score and an overfitting score, balanced by a penalty term. Extensive experiments across four benchmark datasets demonstrate that POBF consistently improves performance, achieving an average gain of 5.83\% over the real-data-only method and outperforming leading baselines by 2.29\%-3.85\% in accuracy. translated_title: 框外作画：视觉定位训练数据的合成与选择
translated_abstract: 视觉定位旨在根据文本查询定位图像中的相应区域。鉴于大规模数据整理的困难，本文研究了如何在数据稀缺的设置下有效学习视觉定位。为解决数据稀缺问题，我们提出了一种新颖的框架 POBF（Paint Outside the Box and Filter，框外作画与过滤）。POBF 通过在边界框之外进行图像修复来合成图像，解决了以往工作中遇到的标签错位问题。此外，POBF 利用一种创新的过滤方案来选择最有效的训练数据。该方案结合了难度分数和过拟合分数，并通过一个惩罚项加以平衡。在四个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，POBF 持续提升性能，相比仅使用真实数据的方法平均提升 5.83%，在准确率上超越领先的基线方法 2.29%-3.85%。
tldr: 提出 POBF 框架，通过在边界框外进行图像修复来合成训练数据以解决标签错位问题，并利用结合难度分数与过拟合分数的过滤机制筛选最有效的训练数据，从而在数据稀缺条件下显著提升视觉定位性能。
en_tdlr: The POBF framework synthesizes training data by inpainting outside the box to address label misalignment and selects the most effective samples via a filtering scheme combining hardness and overfitting scores, significantly improving visual grounding performance in data-scarce settings.
